title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Schedule of Statutory Limits by Form and Occupancy
content:
The statutory limits that may be written on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) are fixed per form and occupancy tier. Building and contents coverage are each available on every tier. On a General Property Form tier the building limit has a fixed statutory maximum per building; on an RCBAP tier that fixed figure is 0 and the cap is instead set per residential unit, the building cap being the lower of the per-unit amount times the number of units and the replacement cost value. Limits are written in the increment shown. Increased Cost of Compliance (ICC) coverage, where it attaches, is a limit per building per loss in addition to the building limit.

## Limits schedule

| Tier | Building coverage available | Contents coverage available | Fixed maximum building coverage (USD) | Building limit per residential unit (USD) | Maximum contents coverage (USD) | Increment (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Condominium Unit | yes | yes | 500000 | 0 | 500000 | 100 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Manufactured Building | yes | yes | 500000 | 0 | 500000 | 100 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Other Residential Building | yes | yes | 500000 | 0 | 100000 | 100 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Building | yes | yes | 500000 | 0 | 500000 | 100 |
| NFIP RCBAP – Two-to-Four Unit Condominium Building | yes | yes | 0 | 250000 | 100000 | 100 |
| NFIP RCBAP – Five-or-More Unit Condominium Building | yes | yes | 0 | 250000 | 100000 | 100 |

## Whose contents are insured, and ICC

| Tier | Contents coverage insures | ICC coverage attaches | ICC limit per building per loss (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Condominium Unit | business-owned property | no | 0 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Manufactured Building | business-owned property | yes | 30000 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Other Residential Building | the owner's property in the building | yes | 30000 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Building | business-owned property | yes | 30000 |
| NFIP RCBAP – Two-to-Four Unit Condominium Building | the association's common property | yes | 30000 |
| NFIP RCBAP – Five-or-More Unit Condominium Building | the association's common property | yes | 30000 |

The maximum contents coverage is stated per building or unit. Where ICC does not attach the ICC limit is shown as 0.

## Reading the schedule

- **A General Property Form building.** The building limit can never exceed 500000 on any of the four General Property Form tiers, whatever the number of units shown.
- **An RCBAP building (hypothetical).** For an association building with 3 units and a stated replacement cost value of 900,000, the per-unit amount times the units is 750,000, which is lower than 900,000, so the building cap is 750,000. With the same 3 units and a replacement cost value of 600,000, the cap is 600,000.
- **Contents on an RCBAP.** The association's contents limit can reach 100000 at most, and it insures only the association's common property.

## Parameter meanings

- Whether building coverage may be written on this tier; boolean.
- Whether contents coverage may be written on this tier; boolean.
- Statutory maximum building coverage per building for a General Property Form tier; USD (0 on RCBAP tiers, whose cap is per unit).
- Statutory building coverage available per residential unit under an RCBAP, the building cap being the lower of this times the number of units and the replacement cost value; USD (0 on General Property Form tiers).
- Statutory maximum contents coverage per building or unit; USD.
- Increment in which limits are written; USD.
- Whose property the contents coverage insures; enum (business-owned property, owner property in building, association common property).
- Whether Increased Cost of Compliance coverage attaches; boolean.
- Increased Cost of Compliance limit per building per loss, in addition to the building limit; USD (0 where not available).
